maintenance.message: We're upgrading LeetSync! Be right back.

2.0.0: Every submission is now recorded, not just the accepted ones — filter Solved by what took you several tries, or what you have not revisited
Write notes on any problem; they go into that problem's page in your repo
Pick a username when you connect GitHub, unique across LeetSync
README index collapses into per-difficulty sections once it outgrows a flat table, so a large repo stays readable
README gains a rolling-year solve calendar, and difficulty badges now show progress against LeetCode's real totals
Usage reporting is asked once during setup instead of hiding in Settings, and still starts off
Sharing your solution code is a separate switch that stays off even when reporting is on
An activity ping, on by default and with its own switch: a random ID and the version, twice a day at most, so a dormant install is not mistaken for one that declined reporting — nothing else is sent

Use LeetSync on two computers: sign in with the same token and repo and your solved problems, streak, achievements and sheet ticks merge through your own repository — and there is now a Sign out button
A public leaderboard in the Battle tab — all time, this week and today, plus your own position. Hard 10, Medium 5, Easy 3, counted once per problem. Turn on usage reporting to be ranked
Fixed: the weekly challenge bar showed a number next to an empty bar
Fixed: runtime and memory were always blank on synced solutions
Fixed: release notes could silently fail to appear after an update
Send feedback, an issue or a suggestion from Settings — and get an answer back inside the extension, quoting what you wrote
1.6.0: Sheet ticks now sync across devices and survive a reinstall
New All sheets view — 895 unique problems across the seven sheets
Export and import your progress; your token is never included
Full keyboard navigation with arrow keys through the tabs
Sheets can update without waiting on a store release
Fixed: the footer dashboard button and the wizard step counter did nothing
1.5.0: Seven real study sheets — Striver A2Z, SDE, Blind 75 and 79, Love Babbar 450, NeetCode 150 and 250
1,667 problems, 1,152 of which tick themselves as you solve
Tick anything off-LeetCode by hand; progress is kept per sheet
Show more opens a full tracker in its own tab, with search and filters
Achievements redrawn as custom icons — no more platform emoji
Repository row opens your repo on GitHub
Set up from just your token — LeetSync finds the repo or creates it
Deleting a solution now updates the README on GitHub too
1.4.0: New Sheets tab — Top Interview 150, Top 100 Liked, LeetCode 75, DP and Binary Search
Questions tick automatically as you solve them, with per-topic progress
Tap any question to open it on LeetCode in a new tab
403 curated questions, built from LeetCode's own API
1.3.0: Rebuilt popup with two themes — Signal (dark) and Modernist (light)
New README design: badges plus stat panels that follow your GitHub theme
Fixed a broken badge that read "404 badge not found" on every problem
GitHub rate limits are now waited out instead of failing the push
Fine-grained tokens supported — scope access to a single repository
Fonts bundled locally, so the popup makes no network request to open
Download is 98% smaller: 191 KB instead of ~10 MB
1.1.0: 📸 Solution Showcase Cards — share your solves as beautiful PNG images
⚔️ Friend Battle System — add rivals, compare stats, weekly challenges
🔧 Remote config: maintenance mode & update notifications
1.0.0: 🚀 Auto-push accepted LeetCode solutions to GitHub
🎨 6 extension themes (Dark Pro, Glass, Arcade, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Sakura)
📝 5 README themes for your GitHub repo
